		if (string.find(v34, "weight") or (string.find(v34, "وزن") or string.find(v34, "mass"))) and type(v) == "number" then
			return math.floor(v)
		end
	end

	local Hitbox = p1:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
	local v36, isBasePart, clamp, v39

	if not Hitbox then

					return math.floor(v.Value)
				end
			end
		end

		if Hitbox then
			isBasePart = Hitbox:IsA("BasePart")
		else
			isBasePart = Hitbox
		end

		if isBasePart then
			clamp = math.clamp
			v39 = Hitbox.Size.X + Hitbox.Size.Y + Hitbox.Size.Z

			return clamp(math.floor(v39), 1, 100)
		else
			return 5
		end
	end

	for k, v in pairs(Hitbox.GetAttributes(Hitbox)) do

		if (string.find(v44, "weight") or (string.find(v44, "وزن") or string.find(v44, "mass"))) and type(v) == "number" then

		end

			end
